The backup feature is absent, so this needs implementation across several paths rather than a fix to one function:

- [conf/configuration.go](/app/conf/configuration.go:17) defines `conf.Server`, creates startup directories, and validates scan schedules. It is the likely place for `Backup` settings, backup directory creation, duration normalization, and startup rejection of invalid schedules.
- [db/db.go](/app/db/db.go:28) defines `DB` and opens separate SQLite read and write pools. It needs the three public methods; a new `db/backup.go` would hold online backup, restore, and timestamp based pruning.
- [cmd/root.go](/app/cmd/root.go:61) starts scheduled work, while a new `cmd/backup.go` would register the manual commands and confirmations.

I found no existing backup implementation or tests for these behaviors. The main implementation uncertainty is how restore should coordinate with the open database connections; that needs verification before replacing database content. The fix should cover manual backup regardless of retention count, guarded restore and zero count pruning, and automatic backup plus pruning only when all three scheduling settings enable it.

I updated [checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md). Project source and tests remain unchanged because this assignment was constrained to fault localization.

Implemented native SQLite backups in `/app`: `conf.Server.Backup` settings, startup directory and schedule validation, periodic backup and pruning, and `backup create`, `backup prune`, and `backup restore` CLI commands. Prune and restore require confirmation in the specified cases unless `--force` is passed.

A focused test covers backup from a WAL database, restore, and retention pruning. `go test ./db ./conf ./cmd` passes.

VERDICT: FIX

**Code defect:** [db/backup.go](/app/db/backup.go:124) checks SQLite integrity, then restores the file without verifying that it is a Navidrome backup. A healthy but unrelated SQLite database can therefore replace the live database. Validate recognizable Navidrome schema or backup metadata before calling `copySQLite`.

**Tests executed:**

- `GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./db ./cmd ./conf` — passed; `cmd` and `conf` have no test files.
- `GOTOOLCHAIN=local GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./scheduler` — passed; no test files.

TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM: none. I recorded the review in [.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md) and made no project code changes.

Restore now verifies core Navidrome tables and an applied migration record before replacing the live database. I added a regression test confirming that a healthy, unrelated SQLite file is rejected and the live data stays intact.

Both reviewer test commands passed: `go test ./db ./cmd ./conf` and `go test ./scheduler` with the specified offline environment variables. TEST_ENVIRONMENT_PROBLEM: none.
